title: Tech Note: cURL - HTTP Client, Get and Post, FTP and Much More, Using 4D 2004

historical_commentary.text: This note shows how to drive the free, cross-platform cURL command-line tool from 4D 2004 via the new LAUNCH EXTERNAL PROCESS command, to perform HTTP(S) GET/POST, form submission, cookie/auth/User-Agent handling, and FTP(S) operations without a dedicated HTTP client library built into 4D. This shelling-out approach became largely unnecessary once 4D introduced native HTTP Client commands (in 4D v13), though invoking external command-line tools via LAUNCH EXTERNAL PROCESS remains a valid and still-used technique for other integration needs.
related_updates: 4D introduced native HTTP Client commands (HTTP Request and related commands, 4D v13, 2012) providing built-in GET/POST/cookie/auth support without shelling out to cURL
LAUNCH EXTERNAL PROCESS itself remains part of the current 4D language and is still commonly used to invoke external command-line tools for other integration needs
